leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Initialize a Zustand store with state and actions.
Integrate the Zustand store into a React component.
Manipulate global state by invoking store actions from UI events.
Render dynamic content by binding component state to the Zustand store.
Configure a Zustand store to handle multiple state properties.
Apply Zustand to control shared state across multiple components.
